steps.en: Run the Windows installer (or unzip the portable build) and launch it
steps.zh: 跑 Windows 安装器（或解压便携版）并启动

steps.en: On first boot, wires turn hooks into Claude Code and Codex
steps.zh: 首次启动时给 Claude Code 和 Codex 接上回合钩子

steps.en: Open tabs or splits — local, WSL or a saved SSH host — and start your AI CLIs
steps.zh: 开标签或分屏——本地、WSL 或已存的 SSH 主机——启动你的 AI 命令行

steps.en: Maps each hook event to its pane: tab dot and AI sidebar show working or waiting
steps.zh: 把每个钩子事件对到面板：标签圆点和 AI 侧栏显示在跑或在等

steps.en: Raises a notification tied to the source pane when a turn ends or needs you
steps.zh: 回合结束或需要你时，弹出绑定来源面板的通知

steps.en: Click the notification to land in that pane and answer, or read the captured reply
steps.zh: 点通知直接回到那个面板作答，或阅读收下的回答

value.en: You stop cycling through tabs to find which agent finished or is stuck on a prompt
value.zh: 不用再挨个翻标签找哪个 agent 跑完了、哪个卡在确认上

sources: README 'Download' (run the installer or extract the ZIP and launch pebrel.exe) and 'AI CLI Workflows' (activity states, notifications follow their source pane, captured answers open in a reader)

README 'Terminals and Sessions' / 'SSH and Files' (tabs, split panes, WSL and SSH sessions, saved hosts)
